rationality_assessment.reason: The project already has node registry, skill contracts, create grant, and audit tables; adding a redacted execution plan layer is an incremental foundation and can be validated with mock/test_run only.

implementation_plan: Add launch_execution_plans migration and minimal plan_id/idempotency/module_ref audit columns.
Add repository methods for upserting and reading execution plans.
Implement a workflow execution-plan compiler with stable plan_hash and redacted action summaries.
Add a mock smoke test for existing-monitor and missing-monitor scenarios plus grant allowlist checks.
Run existing workflow validation commands and close the task if passed.
non_goals: No real monitor create or retry.
No real resource upload or platform mutation.
No raw secret, cookie, payload, response, or full URL in project files.
outputs: src/repositories/postgresRepository.mjs: execution plan repository methods and plan-aware audit writes
src/workflows/executeConfirmedLaunch.mjs: optional plan scope guardrail validation
